name: AI Automator: Pandoc
description: AI automator that converts Word/PDF files to HTML using pandoc.
project_description: AI Automator: Pandoc is an AI Automators plugin (id pandoc_word_to_html, "Pandoc: Word to HTML") that converts an uploaded document held in a file field into HTML by shelling out to the pandoc command-line tool, writing the result into a text_long target field when the entity is saved. Input format is detected from the file's MIME type and extension (docx/doc, pdf, odt, rtf, html, txt), and per-automator options control the pandoc output: HTML5 or HTML4, line wrapping, standalone wrapper, embedded resources, section numbering, table of contents, and a free-text extra-arguments string. The pandoc binary path is set on a site config form at /admin/config/content/pandoc (config object ai_automator_pandoc.settings), which validates the path and runs 'pandoc --version'; hook_requirements surfaces the status on the report page. A Drush command 'ai-automator-pandoc:test' (alias pandoc-test) runs the same conversion from the CLI for diagnosis. Requires pandoc installed on the server. Depends on core system and the AI module's ai_automators sub-module. Supports Drupal 10.4, 11, and 12.
